stem: Certain species of yeast can reproduce sexually or asexually. Which answer choice best compares the offspring from sexual reproduction to the offspring from asexual reproduction?

options.label: A
options.text: Offspring of sexual reproduction are larger than offspring of asexual reproduction.

options.label: B
options.text: Offspring of sexual reproduction are genetically different from either parent and offspring of asexual reproduction are identical to the parent.

options.label: C
options.text: Offspring of sexual reproduction have twice as much genetic material as the offspring of asexual reproduction.

options.label: D
options.text: Offspring of sexual reproduction are genetically identical to each other and offspring of asexual reproduction are genetically different from each other.
